prompts.text: Name an international brand based in Japan

items.quip: This vinegar maker has owned Ragú pasta sauce since 2014.
items.title: Mizkan
items.extract: Mizkan Holdings  is a Japanese company that produces vinegars, mustards, salad dressings, authentic East Asian sauces, nattō, and other food products. It is based in Handa, Aichi Prefecture, near Nagoya.

prompts.text: Name an insect or arachnid with a one-word name

items.quip: Bred by Brother Adam, a monk at Devon's Buckfast Abbey.
items.title: Buckfast
items.extract: Buckfast is a small village near Buckfastleigh in Teignbridge district, Devon, England, on the bank of the River Dart. It is the home of Buckfast Abbey, an active Benedictine monastery, which gave its name to Buckfast Tonic Wine, originally made there, and to the Buckfast bee, a bee breed originally developed at Buckfast Abbey.

prompts.text: Name a stadium that’s been home to a professional sports team

items.quip: Seventeen-year-old Jackie Mitchell struck out Babe Ruth and Lou Gehrig here.
items.title: Engel Stadium
items.extract: Engel Stadium is a stadium in Chattanooga, Tennessee. The stadium was built in 1930 and holds 12,000 people. It was the home of the Chattanooga Lookouts until 1999 when they moved to their next stadium, AT&T Field. The former Tennessee Temple University held its home games at Engel after the Lookouts left. Engel Stadium was named for longtime President of the Chattanooga Lookouts, Joe Engel.

prompts.text: Name a language that originated in East or Central Asia

items.quip: Chichijima's first settlers, Americans and Hawaiians, seeded this English dialect.
items.title: Bonin English
items.description: English and Japanese-based creole dialects of the Bonin Islands
items.extract: Bonin English, also known as the Bonin Islands language or Ogasawara English, is a group of English varieties spoken on the Bonin Islands of Japan, in the country's far south. This includes Bonin Pidgin English, Bonin Creoloid English, and Bonin Standard English. Besides Bonin English, varieties of Japanese are spoken on the islands, as well as a mixed language called Osagawara Mixed Language.

prompts.text: Name a mountain peak over 2,000 metres above sea level

items.quip: A nuclear-powered CIA spy device lost on it was never recovered.
items.title: Nanda Devi
items.extract: Nanda Devi is the second-highest mountain in India, after Kangchenjunga, and the highest located entirely within the country as Kangchenjunga is on the border of India and Nepal. Nanda Devi is the 23rd-highest peak in the world and ranked 74th by prominence in Chamoli Garhwal district of Uttarakhand, in northern India.

prompts.text: Name a wild member of the cat or dog family

items.quip: Darwin killed one with his geological hammer on Chiloé in 1834.
items.title: Darwin's fox
items.extract: Darwin's fox or Darwin's zorro is an endangered canid from the genus Lycalopex, which is distantly related to wolves and whose members are not true foxes. It is also known as the zorro chilote or zorro de Darwin in Spanish and is endemic to Chile, where it lives in the temperate rainforests of Nahuelbuta National Park, the Cordillera de Oncol, Cordillera Pelada, and Chiloé Island. It is a small, dark-colored species that is distinguished from other Lycalopex by its shorter legs, broader head, and darker pelage.
